title: Thread one accepted planning round through dispatch behind [job_plan]
summary: Implements job 3a of the job-planning design: when [job_plan] enabled and the capability doesn't pin a repository, dispatch runs one planner and one critic invocation (accept-only) after the prediction commit, seeds a Closing with them, and produce_and_verify continues from it. Audience is the Athena maintainer and verifier, who check invocation numbering, budget, send-back prompt and landing-commit contents with the fake driver.

defaults_applied.how: New fake-driver tests plus clippy and fmt criteria.
Criteria check invocation order, budget stop, prompt content and hash rather than wiring.
Only the accept path in run.rs; no revise/stop.
Behavior criteria name cargo test commands.
Fixes F1 and F6 by seeding Closing and recomputing spent, not special-casing.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Test code lives in or alongside crates/athena-core/src/run.rs (existing fake-driver harness); no new crate dependencies.
Planner output is treated as accepted when the critic returns an accept verdict; non-accept verdicts are not handled (job 4) and may return a clear error.
Producer invocation number follows from the seeded Closing's count, per review finding F1.
Fixture config is built inside tests, so athena.toml is not touched.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test: a fake-driver test with a fixture config having [job_plan] enabled = true yields invocations 01 reader, 02 planner, 03 critic, 04 producer, 05 verifier; the landing commit contains job-plan-1.json, critique-1.json and all five invocation records; check_history() is clean.

Run cargo test: with a fixture cap between producer-alone cost and planning-plus-producer cost, the job stops before the producer is invoked and the failure names the budget, proving spent is recomputed after planning.

Run cargo test: on a forced send-back the second producer prompt still contains the 'Job plan (accepted, round 1)' section, and job-plan-1.json's producer_section_sha256 equals the sha256 of the rendered section.

Run cargo test: with [job_plan] absent, enabled = false, or for a study job (or a capability pinning a repository), the invocations and records are identical to current behavior; all existing tests pass.
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check pass, and xtask's boundary test passes under cargo test.

Planner and critic are recorded through agent_spec and invoke_and_record as Role::Planner and Role::Critic using the job-2 briefs; the producer prompt is brief-producer.md plus render_plan_section, and the send-back is built from that same augmented prompt.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the planning round plumbing; athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unchanged.

out_of_scope: Revise and stop paths of planning (job 4)
Athena's own checks on the plan
departures: Touches the central dispatch path in a large run.rs with multiple precise test criteria, so slightly higher cost and lower pass odds than reference.
